preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of colors N in each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each color value A[i] must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of mixing operations required to make all color values distinct.
